meta.title: Ye Mai | Creative Portfolio
meta.description: Portfolio for Ye Mai, featuring creative technology, immersive media, and interactive research projects.

hero.kicker: creative technologist / XR developer / Web developer
hero.title: Ye Mai

artist.heading: creative technologist, XR developer, and web developer
body: I build interactive systems where spatial interfaces, web engineering, and visual storytelling meet. My work moves between XR prototypes, browser-based experiences, research-driven interfaces, and visual narratives.

This portfolio is shaped as a working studio reel: technical enough for engineering review, visual enough for creative collaboration, and direct enough for HCI, XR, and creative technology opportunities.

items.title: VR Developer
items.description: Build immersive XR prototypes and interactive 3D experiences across headset workflows, real-time scenes, and spatial interfaces.

items.title: Web Developer
items.description: Develop responsive interfaces, back-end services, and reliable product workflows from prototype to deployment.

items.title: Creative Technologist
items.description: Blend visual design, interaction concepts, and hands-on making to shape expressive digital experiences and portfolio-ready prototypes.

projectsSection.heading: Three directions of work: visual narrative, cultural research, and XR interaction.

projects.title: Qianfan One Scroll
projects.summary: A noir-inspired visual system for a tabletop mystery experience, combining bold interface layouts, character art, and case-material storytelling.
projects.alt: Qianfan One Scroll cover mockup with Chinese title, tabletop map, red annotation, and illustrated characters
projects.detailHeading: A tabletop mystery visual system built from noir contrast, annotated evidence, and character-driven interface art.
detailBody: Qianfan One Scroll uses bold graphic composition, case-material layouts, and illustrated player characters to frame a tabletop reasoning experience.
The project works well as the portfolio's visual narrative anchor because it shows art direction, UI composition, and story-facing design in one media-heavy package.

projects.title: Midnight at the Pagoda
projects.summary: A research-led cultural heritage project exploring exhibition space, Buddhist pagoda reconstruction, and visitor-facing interpretation.
projects.alt: Rendered pagoda exhibition scene with warm interior lighting and red architectural elements
projects.detailHeading: An HCI and cultural heritage research project translating pagoda reconstruction into visitor-facing spatial experience.
detailBody: Midnight at the Pagoda explores how exhibition design, historical reconstruction, and interactive interpretation can make cultural heritage feel legible and atmospheric.
The project sits between research and visual production, with rendered scenes, exhibition references, and interpretive diagrams supporting the final experience.

detailMedia.alt: Midnight at the Pagoda rendered scene

projects.title: Vislab Onboarding Panel
projects.summary: A VR onboarding interface demo for guided user flows, spatial panels, and headset-based interaction feedback.
projects.alt: GAVIS onboarding thumbnail with VR headset user and floating video panel
projects.detailHeading: A VR onboarding panel system for guided headset interaction and spatial UI learning.
detailBody: Vislab Onboarding Panel documents an XR interface workflow for orienting users inside a headset experience.
The work emphasizes readable spatial panels, guided interaction states, and practical implementation across Unity and Meta SDK workflows.

contact.note: Open to XR, creative tech, and HCI research opportunities.
